title: Money
description: Class 3 IMO — Money: notes and coins, converting rupees to paise, adding and subtracting money, and shopping word problems with bills and change.

topics.title: Notes, Coins & Rupees–Paise
topics.concept:
Indian money is counted in rupees (₹) and paise. We have coins of ₹1, ₹2, ₹5 and ₹10 and notes of ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100, ₹200, ₹500.

One rupee equals 100 paise, so ₹1 = 100 paise. To change rupees to paise, multiply by 100 (₹3 = 300 paise); to change paise to rupees, divide by 100 (500 paise = ₹5).

examples.problem: How many paise are there in ₹2?

recap: Rupees to paise: multiply by 100. Paise to rupees: divide by 100.

quiz.q: How many paise are there in ₹3?

quiz.explanation: 200 paise = ₹2 and 50 paise left, so ₹2 and 50 paise.

topics.title: Adding & Subtracting Money
topics.concept: We add and subtract money just like ordinary numbers, keeping the ₹ sign. To find a total bill, add the prices. To find the change, subtract the bill from the money given.
recap: Add prices to get the total bill.

topics.title: Shopping & Change
topics.concept: While shopping we add the prices of all items for the bill, then subtract from the money we pay to find the change. Sometimes we check whether the money is enough.

examples.problem: A book costs ₹85 and a pen ₹40. You pay ₹200. What change do you get?
Pens cost ₹12 each. How much for 5 pens?

quiz.q: A notebook costs ₹250 and a geometry box ₹175. What is the total bill?
You pay ₹100 for goods worth ₹68. How much change do you get?

questions.q: Which is more money — 350 paise or ₹4?
questions.explanation: ₹4 = 400 paise, which is more than 350 paise.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three equal ₹50)?
A toy costs ₹125. How much for 2 toys?
₹4 and 75 paise is the same as how many paise?
A notebook costs ₹35 and a pen ₹15. You pay ₹100. How much change?
Meena had ₹2,000 and spent ₹1,250 on groceries. How much is left?
A toy car costs ₹85. How much for 3 toy cars?
You have ₹500 and buy items for ₹125 and ₹240. How much change do you get?
Chocolates cost ₹8 each. With ₹50, what is the most you can buy?
questions.explanation: 6 chocolates cost 6 × 8 = ₹48 (₹2 left); 7 would cost ₹56, too much.
